text to the clipboard, or its path for binary files.
# dsh-copy-document-preview
One-click **copy** button for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar document preview.

The official preview header shows the path, the renderer picker, the wrap toggle
and Reload — but no

thing that gets the document out of the pane. This plugin adds
one button there: click it and the pr
eviewed file's text is on your clipboard.
English | 中文
## What it does

- **A copy button in the document preview header**, rendered after the preview's own
controls and af

ter *Open in app*.
- **Copies the whole file**, not just the part the preview has loaded: the plugin

reads
the file through the harness's own paged file Remote (`remote.workspaceFiles.read`),
the same

reader the preview itself uses, and never bypasses the Session that owns
the file.
- **Binary files

copy their path instead.** For a PDF, image or Office document the
Host reports `workspace-file/not

-text`; the button then copies the file's absolute
path and says so, rather than failing silently.
-

**Clear feedback.** A check mark for two seconds after a successful copy, a warning
mark and a reas

on on failure, both announced to assistive technology.
- **Text files copy their text.** Markdown, p

lain text and code files are copied as
their source text; the copy does not include the preview's li

nd code files are copied as
their source text; the copy does not include the preview's line numbers.
| Preview | What lands on the clipboard |

| Plain text, Markdown, code, logs | The file's full text |
| CSV / TSV / JSON / YAML | The file's f

ull text |
| PDF, image, Office (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`), zip, binary | The file's absolute path

ll text |
| PDF, image, Office (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`), zip, binary | The file's absolute path |

## How it works

The plugin has no build step and no runtime dependencies. Its browser half registers
one entry in th

e document toolbar's additive list slot
(`sidebar.right.tab.document.actions`), a slot that only app

ends, so no existing
control is replaced.

- The slot hands the entry the file's `absolutePath`; the Session id, the locale
function and the st

andard hooks come from the slot runtime.
- Reading uses `remote.workspaceFiles.read(sessionId, path,

{ offset }, signal)`, the
same Remote the preview uses, so the file is read with the previewing Ses

sion's own
authority and the host's byte and line limits still apply.
- The browser half never impor

ts a Harness Client package, styles itself with the
host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens (so it follo

ws light and dark mode), and routes
every visible string through the client locale service (English

and Simplified
Chinese).
- Nothing is written outside the plugin's own component, and the button is

the only
DOM it owns.
## Limitations

- The clipboard write uses `navigator.clipboard`, so the page must be a secure
context (`https://` o

r `http://127.0.0.1`) and focused. There is no
`execCommand('copy')` fallback.
- A file larger than

the host's per-page limits (`maxLines`, `maxBytes`) fails with
the host's own `too-large` error, and

so does a file with more than 200 pages.
- Binary files copy their path; the plugin cannot extract

with more than 200 pages.
- Binary files copy their path; the plugin cannot extract text from them.
